author: Mrgerry
text:
I'm headstrong. If I don't understand this stuff of FL's I will study. I take USDJPY chart on H1 and try to tell about the story of these last days

After an FTB on FL (E) price make an FL at A), after that broke the last LOW

go down go down... cluster... exaustion with DBR... price go up really fast...

B) price return back on A).. with an FL, touching FL-A); the reaction was not strong and FL was engulfed C)

after engulfing price touch old FL-A) and add orders to go UP... Price engulf also FL-E) which was already FTBed.. The target now is obviously the supply on the top, but it's necessary to carry on other orders, other buyers...

Slowly slowly buyers liquidate some position and when they arrive in the FL-B), which in the past was important for the break out, add orders and reach supply on the top.

Other FL's I'm not able to identify... I don't distinguish DP from FL... at my eyes these are FL's. In what am I in wrong?
